scope: Keep the existing conservative neighbour-query speed bound valid when a native stat reset increases base speed on an actor with an independent additive bonus.
sourceFacts: Unit.current_stats.speed and bonus_speed are separate; reset_speed_stat changes the former and preserves the latter. Pursuer.boost_self adds to bonus_speed and its movement uses current_stats.speed+bonus_speed.

World uses maxRadius+maxSpeed*dt as the conservative hash-query padding because neighbours may already have moved since the hash was built. Native reset must include the preserved positive bonus in maxSpeed.

focused.NativeStatReset: 8/0; new actual BabyTrex growth/reset regression initially7/1

proof: Actual registered BabyTrex advances its native Pursuer timer and gains a positive source speed bonus; the test does not fabricate that bonus.
Native stat reset preserves that independent bonus, then the cached maxSpeed must bound combined base*factor*boost+bonus. Old reset left a too-small bound; one expression now includes speedBonuses.
This proves the speed-bound invariant and source bonus preservation, not an entire native collision solver or observed on-screen collision fix.
